Caffeine documentation

Stable Engine Doppio Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: devscafecommunity/caffeine

The Caffeine Engine is a C++20 engine on SDL3. Doppio is its Rust/Iced editor. The engine exposes a stable C ABI so any frontend can drive it, and the editor talks to it through libcaffeine-capi.

New here? Start with Getting started and the Quick start, then take the visual tour in the UI gallery.

Status of this documentation#

The tree mixes current guides and historical plans. Every page starts with a status badge:

Badge Meaning
Stable Verified against the current source and safe to follow.
Beta Implemented but still changing.
Reference API or module reference; check the linked header.
Planned Design only; no current implementation.
Historical Kept for context; not current API.

Plans under plans/ are historical unless the page says otherwise. They document decisions and sessions, not the current editor.

Editing the docs#

The authoring standard is HTML-first Markdown: DOCS_STYLE.md. Every page needs a doc-meta strip, figures for screenshots and relative links that stay inside the docs tree. Source links use absolute GitHub URLs.

bash
cd caffeine-website
python3 scripts/audit-docs.py --include-engine
python3 scripts/audit-docs-i18n.py

Screenshots are generated by the headless driver, never by a desktop screenshot:

bash
./scripts/capture-editor-docs.sh
